title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on diligence, wisdom and noble conduct
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam  highlighting the importance of wisdom, diligence and noble conduct in the creation of a virtuous society. The verse urges individuals to follow the path of light and wisdom, remain vigilant and steadfast in their efforts, and contribute towards building a noble and virtuous society:
"तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान्।
अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम्॥"
The Prime Minister posted on X:
तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान्।
अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम्॥
तन्तुं तन्वन्रजसो भानुमन्विहि ज्योतिष्मतः पथो रक्ष धिया कृतान्। अनुल्बणं वयत जोगुवामपो मनुर्भव जनया दैव्यं जनम्॥ pic.twitter.com/hB4MEzeWC9 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 27, 2026

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media platform X emphasizing wisdom, diligence and noble conduct in building a virtuous society. The verse urges individuals to follow the path of light and wisdom while remaining steadfast in their efforts.
enrichment.context: This is a routine social media post by the Prime Minister sharing a Sanskrit verse (Subhashitam), a genre of short aphoristic sayings conveying moral or philosophical wisdom. Such posts are a recurring feature of the PM's communication style, often shared to mark cultural or reflective moments, and do not carry policy or governance content.
